summary: Full Stack and Mobile Developer with 3+ years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications using React, React Native, Next.js, and Node.js across OTT streaming, fintech, e-commerce, and logistics domains. Proven track record delivering solutions spanning Smart TV and mobile video streaming (1M+ downloads), secure UPI payments and digital lending flows, multi-channel e-commerce platforms, and automated logistics with courier shipping integrations. Author of 7 open-source npm packages with 20,000+ weekly downloads.

bullets: Built digital lending and credit-line flows in React Native and TypeScript, connecting DigiLocker identity checks, bank-statement sharing, and instant account verification so users can apply for a loan with less paperwork.

Built the mobile side of UPI payments with two bank partners (NSDL Payments Bank and IndusInd) in Kotlin and Swift, including payments that complete in under a second and UPI Lite balances that stay in sync offline.
Added on-device security checks in Kotlin and Swift that block rooted or jailbroken phones, debugging tools, and fake overlay screens before a user can enter payment details.
Stored payment credentials in the phone's secure storage and pinned the app to trusted server certificates so payment traffic cannot be intercepted.
Added automatic loan repayments through bank mandates and UPI AutoPay, plus bill payments, so collections no longer depend on manual follow-up.

Architected an enterprise Order Management System (OMS) backend using Hono, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM), with BullMQ workers handling automated order workflows, multi-courier AWB allocation (including India Post), and barcode generation.

Built LogiScan, a React Native mobile application for warehouse logistics, enabling camera-based barcode scanning for order dispatch and RTO (Return to Origin) intake, with encrypted MMKV storage and live status analytics.

Engineered an asynchronous, idempotent webhook ingestion pipeline using Redis and BullMQ to sync multi-channel e-commerce orders, SKU-level inventory, and automated payment/refund processing in real time.

Developed a high-performance sales CRM in React 19, Vite, and TypeScript with TanStack Query and TanStack Table, implementing automated priority lead pool distribution, call activity tracking, and conversion funnel analytics.

Engineered cross-platform media streaming applications in React Native for ThinQ Media (1M+ downloads), optimizing HLS video playback startup latency and building 10-foot UI focus navigation for Apple TV and Android TV.

Developed core features for AppsOnAir, a mobile app release management platform serving 50,000+ users, streamlining over-the-air (OTA) build artifact parsing (APK/AAB/IPA) and implementing cross-platform in-app update SDK lifecycles.

Architected collaborative mobile features in React Native and TypeScript for ContactBook, implementing shared workspace spaces, granular role-based access control (RBAC), and offline-first two-way contact synchronization.

Authored and published 7 open-source React Native libraries (covering TV remote focus navigation, in-app update handling, tvOS SSL pinning, and foldable posture detection), garnering 20,000+ weekly npm downloads.

Engineered a Shopify-like e-commerce web application and merchant admin portal in Next.js, Node.js, and Redux Toolkit, featuring dynamic product catalogs, multi-step cart checkout flows, secure payment gateway integrations, and SSR-driven performance.

Developed a comprehensive School Learning Management System (LMS) using React, Node.js, and REST APIs, delivering role-based portals for teachers, students, and administrators with course management, attendance tracking, and grade reporting.

Architected and shipped 6 production cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and PHP/MySQL REST APIs, delivering responsive user interfaces, secure backend data integrations, and meeting strict release milestones within a 6-month delivery window.
